traditionalDress.men: Veshti, often with a shirt or traditional angavastram for formal or festive settings.
traditionalDress.women: Saree, with Kanchipuram silk sarees especially associated with ceremonial dress.

festivals.name: Pongal
festivals.description: A multi-day harvest festival centred on thanksgiving, decorated homes, new rice and the celebration of agrarian life.

festivals.name: Tamil New Year (Puthandu)
festivals.description: The Tamil calendar new year, observed with home rituals, festive meals and visits with family.

festivals.name: Karthigai Deepam
festivals.description: A festival of lights observed in Tamil Nadu, strongly associated with the hill shrine of Tiruvannamalai.

artsCrafts: Bronze casting using the lost-wax tradition
folklore: Tamil cultural memory includes Sangam-era literary traditions, devotional bhakti poetry and village performance forms. Stories of deities, heroes and moral ideals continue through songs, dance and temple arts.
